race_context: The offices on the state list belong to the Richland-Bean Blossom Community School Corporation (RBBCSC) in Monroe County, whose territory is Richland and Bean Blossom townships, including Ellettsville and Stinesville; the state list adds the county name to the corporation's name {in_list}{bsq_2024}{rbb_taxinfo}. It runs Edgewood Early Childhood Center and Edgewood Primary, Intermediate, Junior High and High schools, with offices at 600 S. Edgewood Drive in Ellettsville {rbb_home}{rbb_budget2027}. Federal data list 2,776 students and five schools in 2024-25 {nces_rbb}. Jerry Sanders is superintendent under a contract running July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2028 {rbb_supt}.

The board has five members serving four-year terms: two must live in Richland Township, two in Bean Blossom Township and one may live anywhere in the corporation; all voters in the corporation vote for every seat, and the residence districts only set where a candidate must live {bsq_2024}. Candidates file a petition signed by 10 registered voters who live in the corporation plus a statement of economic interests {bsq_2024}.

Seats on the 2026 ballot: one Richland seat and one Bean Blossom seat, each electing one member, which matches the state list's 'vote for 1' {in_list}{bsq_2024}. Dana Kerr holds a Richland seat and Angie Jacobs a Bean Blossom seat; B Square Bulletin reported in 2024 that they were the two members whose terms were not then expiring {bsq_2024}. Neither is on the 2026 ballot, so both seats will have new members {bsq_2024}{in_list}. Jimmie Durnil (Bean Blossom), Larry DeMoss (Richland) and Brad Tucker (at-large) were elected in 2024 and are not up this year {bsq_2024}.
Board officers: Kerr is president, Durnil vice president and DeMoss secretary, according to signed 2026 minutes {rbb_min_20260818}{rbb_board}.

Construction: 2026 agendas list items to advertise bids for roofs and mechanical work (January 20), award a roof bid to RoofLynx and an HVAC bid to Harrell Fish (February 24 special meeting), consider a traffic circulation study and an early childhood center playground agreement (March 24), and award a baseball/softball turf bid (April 21) {rbb_ag_20260120}{rbb_ag_20260224}{rbb_ag_20260324}{rbb_ag_20260421}. On August 18, 2026 the board voted 5-0 to award bids for additions and renovations at Edgewood Junior High and Edgewood High; the minutes record a board member saying the building project bids 'came in under' {rbb_min_20260818}.

Budget and taxes: the 2027 budget notice lists a $42.5 million budget estimate across debt service, education and operations funds, an estimated property tax cap credit of $1,074,900, and levy increases of 5.82% (debt service) and 6.04% (operations); the board held its hearing September 15 and plans to adopt the budget October 20, 2026 {rbb_budget2027}. The January 20, 2026 agenda included an addendum to the district's agreement with Policy Analytics; the documents reviewed do not describe the effect of the 2025 property-tax law (SEA 1) on the district {rbb_ag_20260120}.

Staffing and student services: 2026 agendas list creating a network/security administrator position (January), new positions and an artificial intelligence guide (May), and new K-12 mental health coordinator and student success coordinator positions (June agenda) {rbb_ag_20260120}{rbb_ag_20260519}{rbb_ag_20260616}. At the August 18 meeting, three people spoke during visitor comments about special education at Edgewood Primary School, and board members said they would follow up {rbb_min_20260818}.

Cell phone policy: on July 21, 2026 the board discussed revising Policy 5136 on personal communication devices and put off a decision; at a July 30 special meeting the three members present approved the revision 3-0 {rbb_min_20260721}{rbb_min_20260730}.
Votes recorded in the 2026 minutes reviewed for this guide were unanimous among members present {rbb_min_20260721}{rbb_min_20260730}{rbb_min_20260818}.

Forums: no candidate forum or questionnaire for this race was found. Jeremiah O'neal is listed as a write-in candidate, so his name will not be printed on the ballot; voters must write it in {in_list}.
